# Cully v0.6.0

One setup command starts the complete local Cully stack. Run `cully setup` to prepare configuration, start both databases, apply migrations, start Mem0, the data API and MCP, connect detected coding agents, install skills and hooks, and start the advisor daemon. Setup logs seven stages and reports completion only after the advisor is running. Failures return a nonzero exit status with retry guidance.

## Breaking setup changes

- `cully agent setup` has been removed. Use `cully setup --agent codex` (or `claude`, `cursor`, `all`) for local setup. Bare `cully setup` now also installs integrations for detected agents and starts the advisor.
- To connect an existing server, use `cully setup --agent codex --mcp-url URL`, adding `--oauth` when required. This configures the local integrations and advisor without starting Docker services.
- The installer installs the CLI and prints the setup command. Run `cully setup` afterwards to start all local components. Installer calls with `--mcp-url` perform existing-server setup automatically.

`--prepare` still only downloads the stack and prepares editable configuration. Setup now installs project hooks in the directory where the command was invoked, rather than inside the downloaded stack. Repeated setup reuses credentials and the running advisor.
